ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A resident of Auto Town was interested in finding the cheapest gas prices at nearby gas stations. On randomly selected days over a period of one month, he recorded the gas prices (in dollars) at four gas stations near his house. The boxplots of gas prices are as follows: Based on this display, which of the stations had the closest mean and median during the month?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a box plot of gasoline prices at four gas stations (Station 1 to Station 4), with the vertical axis as price (dollars), approximately from 1.6 to 2.1. The median line in the box of Station 2 is close to the center of the box, and the lengths of the upper and lower whiskers are also relatively close, so overall it looks the most symmetric. The box and whiskers of Station 1 are slightly unbalanced. The median line of Station 3 is close to the upper part of the box, and the lower half is longer, showing obvious skewness. Station 4 has two relatively high outliers, which will pull the mean upward. Reasoning: The question asks which station has the mean and median closest in this month. Generally speaking, the more symmetric the distribution, the closer the mean and median are; when it is skewed or has outliers, the mean will be pulled away from the median. Among the four box plots, Station 2 is closest to symmetric, therefore its mean and median are the closest.

raw_record.question_text: Based on the boxplots of gas prices, which station had the closest mean and median during the month?

method.method_draft: Inspect the four gas-price boxplots and compare how symmetric each station’s distribution appears. Read from the image that Station 2 has a box with the median line near the center and whiskers of nearly equal length, while Station 1 is somewhat uneven, Station 3 is strongly skewed with the median near the top of the box, and Station 4 has high outliers that would pull the mean upward. Use the text question to identify that the goal is to choose the station whose mean and median are closest. Apply the rule that in a roughly symmetric distribution, the mean and median are closest, whereas skewness or outliers separate them. Therefore choose Station 2.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是四个加油站（Station 1 到 Station 4）的汽油价格箱线图，纵轴为价格（dollars），大约从 1.6 到 2.1。Station 2 的箱体中位数线接近箱体中心，上下须长度也比较接近，整体看起来最对称。Station 1 的箱体和须略不均衡。Station 3 的中位数线靠近箱体上方，下半部分更长，显示明显偏斜。Station 4 有两个较高的离群点，会把平均数向上拉。
推理：题目问哪个站点在这个月的平均数和中位数最接近。一般来说，分布越对称，平均数和中位数越接近；偏斜或有离群点时，平均数会被拉离中位数。四个箱线图中 Station 2 最接近对称，因此它的平均数和中位数最接近。
